## ---- Assembly ----
```bash
ln -s /pvol/data/metagenome_assembly/bbd_0.1.fastq.gz . 
# Create a symbolic link to the BBD read data

flye --nano-hq bbd_0.1.fastq.gz --threads 12 --out-dir bbd --meta 
# Assembles the sequences as slurm script, full script in separate file
``` 


## ---- Binning ----

```bash
cat ../flye/bbd/assembly_info.txt  | grep -v '#' | awk '{OFS="\t";print $1,$3}' > depths_bbd.txt
# Extracting depth information

cat ../flye/depths_bbd.txt | awk '{print $1}' | xargs samtools faidx ../flye/bbd/assembly.fasta > assembly_bbd_ordered.fasta
# Reordering the contigs based on depth

metabat2 -i assembly_bbd_ordered.fasta -a depths_bbd.txt --cvExt -o bins_bbd/metabat --seed 5
# Running metabat to perform binning
```

## ---- Checkm ----
```bash 
cat ../flye/bbd/assembly.fasta | bioawk -c fastx '{print length($seq),$name}' | sort -n
# Displaying contigs lengths from shortest to longest

cp ../metabat/bins_bbd/*.fa bins_bbd/
# Copy over all .fa files into bins_bbd folder

samtools faidx ../flye/bbd/assembly.fasta contig_147 > bins_bbd/contig_147.fa
# Extract contig_147 (the longest contig) and creates a new file containing its sequence data

checkm lineage_wf bins_bbd out -t 4 -x fa -f checkm_results_bbd.txt 
# Evaluates compleatness and contaimination as slurm script, full script in separate file

cat checkm_results_bbd.txt | awk '$13>15{print $1}' > bbd_topbins.txt
# Filtering based on compleatness (col 13) being greater than 15%
```


## ---- gtdbtk ----

```bash 
while read bin;do cp "../metabat/bins_bbd/${bin}.fa" genomes;done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt
# This command, reads the bin name, constructs a path using that bin name and then copies the .fa file into a folder called "genomes"

gtdbtk classify_wf -x fa --cpus 2 --genome_dir genomes --out_dir out --skip_ani_screen 
# Taxanomically classifies the genomes using gtdbtk, as slurm script, full script in separate file
```


## ---- Prokka ----

```bash 
head -n 1 ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt 
#To identify the bin used in the next step

bin=metabat.26 
# The bin selected from the last step was metabat.26, this assigns it as a shell variable

prokka --outdir $bin --prefix $bin  ../metabat/bins_bbd/${bin}.fa
# Here prokka annotates the genome and places its files in a self labeled folder

while read bin;do 
  prokka --outdir $bin --prefix $bin "../metabat/bins_bbd/${bin}.fa";
done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt 
# This repeates the previous process but for all bins as a slurm script, full script in separate file.
```

## ---- Pathways ----

```bash 
cat ../prokka/metabat.26/metabat.26.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{OFS="\t";print $1,$5}' | grep -v '^locus' > metabat.26.ec
# This pipe looks at the tsv for metabat.26 and extracts the data from column 1 (it's unique ID) and column 5 (enzyme commission number) for all genes in a tab-separated format.

minpath -ec metabat.26.ec -report metabat.26.ec.report -details metabat.26.ec.details
# Using minpath to infer the minimum set of biological pathways that explain the sequence annotations.

while read bin;do 
  cat ../prokka/$bin/${bin}.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{printf("%s\t%s\n", $1,$5)}' | grep -v '^locus' > ${bin}.ec 
done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt
# This repeats the process that extracts the ID and enzyme commission number for all bins

while read bin;do 
  minpath -ec ${bin}.ec -report ${bin}.ec.report -details ${bin}.ec.details
done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt
# while this repeats the minpath code for each of the outputs

grep 'PWY-101' *.ec.report
# Looking for the specific  photosynthesis light reactions pathway 

grep 'metabat.26' ../gtdbtk/out/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv
# Used to cross-reference the previous results with the gtdbtk outputs
```
